newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.2 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.2 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week are expected to total $2.2 billion in 104 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.

Negotiated offerings total $1.6 billion in 54 sales, with a $106 million Philadelphia School District deal through Merrill Lynch & Co. topping the list. To see the full NEGOTIATED sales calendar, double click on NEGO1.

On the competitive side, 50 sales totaling $618 million are on the schedule. A $200 million New York City deal on Tuesday is the largest. To see the full COMPETITIVE sales calendar, double click on COMP1.
An additional 14 sales totaling $622 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.
For the full NOTE calendar, double click on NOTE1.
